verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec. The probe found 404s at every standard OpenAPI/Swagger path. The llms.txt file, the /mock response-shape mirrors and the MCP server are related agent aids, not a formal API specification, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
